metadata.title: Torn Collage Portrait with Modern Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast portrait of a man in a herringbone suit and fedora, partially obscured by shadows, framed by a torn-paper collage effect that reveals a dark background beneath a warm, sepia-toned foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: The torn paper edge creates a diagonal tension between the light foreground and dark background.
The large-scale display typography at the top anchors the composition.
The shadow from the hat brim creates a mysterious focal point on the subject's face.
coreInvariants: Torn paper texture with white fibrous edges
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows in the eye sockets

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a man from the chest up, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold serif text spanning the top edge of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold header text down to the shadowed face, then following the diagonal torn edge to the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and lower right corners are defined by dark, void-like negative space revealed by the 'tears'.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and cream tones in the central portrait area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black in the background and hat shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the torn paper edges and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the lit face and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing causing slight overlaps in the display header
Vertical orientation for the secondary text on the right margin

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top of the hat and background
Floating in the dark negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and orientation contrast using the same typeface family.
graphicDevices: Torn paper edges with white texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast thick/thin strokes and bold presence.
Provides the elegant, vertical stress required for the 80s editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a grey herringbone suit, white shirt, and patterned tie, wearing a dark fedora that casts a heavy shadow over his eyes. Apply a warm sepia filter. Overlay two large 'torn paper' shapes in the upper left and lower right corners to reveal a dark, textured black background underneath. The torn edges should show white paper fibers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase display text in a bold Didone font across the top, tightly kerned. Add a secondary lowercase phrase in the same font family, rotated 90 degrees clockwise, positioned vertically along the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the herringbone pattern visible on the suit?
Are the eyes obscured by the hat's shadow?
Do the torn edges look like physical paper?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the torn paper edges
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

avoid: Digital-looking clean cuts instead of tears

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white torn edge is distinct from the background.
Check that the text does not have any drop shadows.
Verify the herringbone scale is appropriate for a blazer.
Confirm the vertical text is rotated correctly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion patterned suit portrait with a 'torn collage' frame and oversized Didone typography for a classic 80s editorial aesthetic.
